name: Bank Statement
description: Bank or credit card statement. Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), masked card numbers, full card numbers (13-19 digits), transaction references, dates, phone numbers (US and Canada with extensions, European and international), plus names, addresses, account numbers and amounts.

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: BIC / SWIFT
patterns.description: BIC/SWIFT code together with its BIC: or SWIFT: label, so ordinary uppercase words are not taken.

patterns.name: Masked card
patterns.description: Card number with masked digits and the last 4 visible (****1234).

patterns.name: Card number
patterns.description: Full card number: 13 to 19 digits with optional spaces or dashes (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, UnionPay).

patterns.name: Reference
patterns.description: Transaction or reference ID starting with TXN, TRX, REF or RIF, dashes inside allowed.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: US and Canada numbers with area code (parentheses included), 7-digit local numbers like 555-0142, extensions (ext. 12, x12), international numbers with + or 00, and French, Italian, German, Spanish and UK formats. Plain digit runs only right after a phone label. Amounts, dates, ZIP codes, IBANs, card, account, routing and reference numbers are not taken.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Dates in DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY etc.
